provenance.section: MarketTrade.size — "Base size of the trade", type: string with no documented lower bound
modifications: trades[0].size changed to "0". The venue documents no bound on size; the frozen domain contract requires a POSITIVE decimal for a trade size, because a trade of zero base units is not an observation of a trade.
A second, valid trade follows it in the same batch.

expectation: The zero-size trade is REFUSED at the decimal boundary with a COINBASE_ECONOMIC_FIELD_INVALID anomaly — never clamped, never rounded up, never dropped in silence. The valid trade in the SAME batch is still normalized: one bad entry does not discard a 250 ms batch.
